title: Original component torus action domains and canonical toric comparisons
statement:
Let $k$ be a field, let $M$ be a fine monoscheme with a finite affine cover, and use its toric realization $X=k[M]$, torsion-free connected components $C$, component realizations $X_C$, split tori $T_C$, action $a_C:T_C\times_k X_C\to X_C$, component inclusions $c_C:X_C\to X$, and dense torus embeddings $j_C:T_C\to X$ from [def-trf-monoscheme-toric-realization]. For a scheme map $f:Y\to X$, define $Y_C=Y\times_X X_C$, $D_C(f)=T_C\times_k Y_C$, and $p_f:D_C(f)\to Y$ by the two projections. Define $A_C(f):D_C(f)\to X$ as the map to $T_C\times_k X_C$ followed by $a_C$ and $c_C$. Thus a lift of the original action over $f$ is a morphism $\mu:D_C(f)\to Y$ satisfying $f\mu=A_C(f)$.

For $f:Y\to X$, $g:Z\to X$ and a scheme isomorphism $e:Y\simeq Z$, define a toric comparison to mean: $g e=f$; for every $C$ there is a unique such lift $\mu$ for $f$ and a unique such lift $\nu$ for $g$; and for every pair of these lifts there is a morphism $b:D_C(f)\to D_C(g)$ whose torus projection is unchanged, whose projection to $Z$ is $e p_f$, and whose projection to $X_C$ is unchanged, satisfying $e\mu=\nu b$. Finally for every $C$ require open immersions $j:T_C\to Y$, $l:T_C\to Z$ with $f j=j_C$, $g l=j_C$, and $e j=l$, whose image closures are respectively $f^{-1}(X_C)$ and $g^{-1}(X_C)$. This records equivariance over the original action and preservation of the original dense component torus, with no existence assertion for arbitrary modifications. Empty component sets are permitted.
